text: Apple Inc. is listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market. Its 2026 proxy statement, under 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management', lists only two persons known to Apple to beneficially own more than 5% of its common stock as of January 2, 2026: The Vanguard Group (9.63%) and BlackRock, Inc. (7.10%), both investment managers.
short: Apple's 2026 proxy statement lists The Vanguard Group (9.63%) and BlackRock, Inc. (7.10%) as the only shareholders above 5%.

source.name: Apple Inc. 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management (SEC EDGAR, filed 2026-01-08)

additionalSources.name: AI Funding Tracker (Sheldon Blake): Who Owns Apple in 2026? Largest Shareholders Explained
additionalSources.quote: No single person or company owns Apple. The Vanguard Group is the largest shareholder with 9.63% of common stock as of January 2026, followed by BlackRock at 7.10%.
